items.title: 考前提醒
items.content: 【考前提醒】请考生登录报名系统，及时下载并打印准考证；居家网考考生还须下载最新版考试客户端，并按要求做好考前准备。
items.contentEn: [Reminder] Please log in to the CSCA registration system to download and print your Admission Ticket in advance. Home-based test takers must also download the latest version of the test software and complete all required pre-test preparations.
